item.title: [8] Observation of e/4 Charge at ν=1/2 in a Wide GaAs Quantum Well
item.description:
Last authors: Mitali Banerjee, Moty Heiblum

Authors: Tomer Alkalay, Emily Hajigeorgiou, Adbhut Gupta, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental study of fractional quantum Hall states and non-Abelian topological order.

Tags: #quantum-hall #topological

Abstract: Shot-noise measurements through a quantum point contact reveal e/4-charged quasiparticles in the fractional quantum Hall state at ν=1/2, providing evidence consistent with the non-Abelian topological order sought for topological quantum computing.
